canonical_frame.group: G4 = {IDENTITY, MIRROR_X, MIRROR_Y, ROT180} (not full D4)
canonical_frame.selector: legal team-mean own xy (obs entries 0-1, area units) at episode reset; W = x < .5, S = y < .5
canonical_frame.held: chosen at every lane reset, held to the episode end; all agents share it
canonical_frame.physical_side: shield (apply_feedback), guard and env.step receive physical-frame observations and actions; proposals are inverse-transformed before the shield
